description.value: AfterShock Cafe is a coffee shop located in the remote North Coast and Haida Gwaii region of British Columbia, a part of the province with very limited services for touring cyclists. Situated at 69 Upns Avenue, it offers a potential rest stop in an area where cafes are rare. Its Facebook presence suggests an active local establishment, though details about its offerings are unconfirmed.
